title: FX lock file, fx.lock (fx: lock/v1)
description: The source digest behind each versioned project node type (identity.md §6). Planning refuses a type whose source no longer matches its entry. A versioned type with no entry plans normally, and `grida-fx lock --check` reports it as unlocked. Written by `grida-fx lock`; commit it.

nodes.description: `<path>#<attr>@<version>` to `digest(source)`. `<path>` is POSIX, relative to the project root, without `./`.
